title: Fifty minutes, laid out end to end
variant: Two real axes: twelve pixels a minute across, three lanes down
prompt: Write up last night's sign-in outage. I don't want a wall of paragraphs -- I want to see how long the gaps were.
note: The canvas shape, and the widest board of the three at 3,900 pixels, which is deliberate: fitted it is illegible, and the page says so, because at that size the finding is the shape and reading is what the seven-stop tour is for. Cards are heterogeneous on purpose -- a log excerpt in a code well, a hand-drawn SVG line chart, a support quote, a checklist -- which is the argument for a canvas over a timeline component. Every card prints its own timestamp on its face, so a reader who thinks something is in the wrong place can check the drawing against its own label rather than trusting it.
